pages.text:
Syntax: idle
                 |
                 |Display a list of all visible players with detailed idle and
                 |playtime information.
                 |
                 |Columns displayed:
                 |  Players  - Character name
                 |  Idle     - Number of game ticks idle (1 tick = 1/4 second)
                 |  Hours    - Total hours played (including this session)
                 |  HpL      - Average hours played per level
                 |  Position - Current position (standing, sitting, resting, etc.)
                 |  Status   - Current activity (OLC editor name or Quest if questing)
                 |  Host     - Hostname or IP address of player connection
                 |
                 |Example:
                 |  idle
                 |
                 |This is useful for determining when players have been inactive
                 |or what they are currently doing on the MUD.
